nodes.name: Actions Webhook
nodes.notes:
responseMode onReceived: the caller does NOT wait on this response. It used to be lastNode, so an 8s client timeout decided whether a booking had happened -- four real meetings were created while the visitor was told the slot was unavailable. The outcome now goes back out through Notify Agent OK / Notify Agent Error to POST /api/cal-callback.

POST { action: book|cancel|reschedule, session_id, start?, booking_uid?, attendee:{name,email,timeZone}, reason? }

nodes.name: Validate Request
nodes.notes: Fails fast with a readable message, and converts start to UTC -- Cal.com rejects an offset-bearing start.

nodes.name: Cal Create Booking
nodes.notes: No retryOnFail: POST /v2/bookings is not idempotent, so a retry can create a second meeting for the same visitor. A genuine failure routes to Respond Error and the agent asks for another time.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ cancellationReason: $('Validate Request').item.json.reason || 'Cancelled via AI sales agent' }) }}

nodes.name: Cal Cancel Booking
nodes.notes: Cancelling an already-cancelled booking returns 400 -- the error branch records it rather than retrying forever.

nodes.name: Cal Reschedule Booking
nodes.notes: Returns a NEW booking with a NEW uid; the old one becomes cancelled. Sync Booking State stores the new uid, without which the next cancel would 400.

nodes.name: Sync Booking State
nodes.notes: Unwraps Cal's { status, data } envelope and normalises all three actions into one shape.

nodes.name: Write Booking State
nodes.notes: Stores the (possibly new) uid on agent_runs so inbound Cal webhooks and later cancels can find the run.

nodes.name: Respond OK
nodes.notes: Kept as the shaping node and for the execution log. It is no longer the HTTP response body -- the webhook answers onReceived and the agent learns the outcome from Notify Agent OK.

nodes.name: Respond Error
nodes.notes: Every error path ends here. It is no longer the HTTP response body -- the webhook answers onReceived -- so Notify Agent Error is what actually reaches the agent. The ok flag is still the contract.

nodes.name: Notify Agent OK
nodes.notes: Tells the agent the booking is real, BEFORE Write Booking State. Positioned above it so v1 execution order runs it first: the Supabase write allows 15s and retries 3x5s, and the visitor is waiting on this answer in the chat.

nodes.name: Notify Agent Error
nodes.notes: Tells the agent the action failed, so it says so instead of waiting out its timeout and answering 'still confirming'.
